decisions.statement: An app says which page types it opens its own way, keyed by page type slug.
A page type the app says nothing about is created the way every other one is.
An app naming none of these is the same as no app naming any.
What replaces creating decides for itself whether to open a dialog or write.
Nothing here says whether the add button is drawn, only what pressing it does.

definition: what an app puts in place of creating a page when a view's add button is pressed
